author: BoldAndBrash
body:
Every day, a player can type in /server Repeatrots. This will teleport them to a nebula map.

The map will change every day to make sure it isnt repetitive.
So basically, you can type /server repeatrots and it'll take you to a game of quintus that continuously cyles throughout the day. After 24 hours, the map will finally change.

This is just a small idea I had in mind. ;)
